customReplacement.reason: The product-defining blind A/B review has no matching generic block, and adding a runtime UI dependency solely for this plain-JS local experiment would weaken the stack.

contract.purpose: Help the owner test whether metadata improves apt existing-meme selection without forcing a joke.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Meme Lab helps its owner judge apt existing cultural references by running local, paired, feedback-backed selector experiments.
contract.audience: The owner running English-first local meme-selection experiments.
contract.job: Pre-label a situation, run identical names-only and enriched conditions, judge blind arms, then reveal the diagnosis.
contract.thesis: A crisp white working canvas with pale-blue navigation, mint and yellow state landmarks, restrained borders and the experiment visible immediately.
contract.system: Clean Canvas uses a lightweight workspace rail, compact full-width situation setup and equal A/B comparison panes; catalogue, sources and history remain secondary.
contract.signature: Seeded A/B arm cards that conceal condition labels and rationales until both judgments are recorded.
contract.risk: Candidate names must remain visible for meaningful judgment, so the workflow is condition-blind rather than fully blind; the selected visual system must also scale to catalogue, sources and history.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner selected direction C, Clean Canvas, from the simpler light and colorful second round; the candidate relevance labeller extends that system.
